Sets the topic to subscribe to. The topic specified can be the literal topic
name, or a regular expression that matches multiple topics.

A comma-separated list of options for the command. Set the conflation
interval in the options. For example, to set a conflation interval of 250
milliseconds, provide the following option: conflation=250ms. To set the
conflation interval to 1 minute, provide an option of: conflation=1m .
